title: What Losing Your Temper Actually Proves About a Godly Man
caption:
A flash of temper doesn't make you strong. It makes you honest about who's actually driving.

The words are out before you decide to say them. That's not passion, that's whatever grabbed the wheel first: control slipping, feeling talked down to, looking weak in front of guys watching. Raising your voice takes five seconds. Rebuilding what it cost you takes a lot longer.

The real fight happens earlier than the flashpoint. Whether you slept. Whether you'd already prayed it through. Whether you're carrying something you never dealt with. Win the morning and the moment gets easier to survive.

When you lose it anyway, skip the justification. Tell God first, then tell the guy, plain, no setup. A man who owns it fast earns more trust than a man who never has to answer for it.

Christ isn't after a man with no temper. He's after a man who isn't ruled by one.

#faith #anger #temper #selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
